name: New York Rollercoaster Rush
summary: Take thrill-seekers for a ride on up to 99 exciting New York City rollercoaster tracks! Navigate skyscraping loop-the-loops, jumps & drops in the city that never sleeps! Loop through Central Park, Downtown & more as you race for the best time without flying off the tracks! Speed increases your excitement meter but even small jolts are enough to send carts tumbling onto the Manhattan streets below!
